modmenu.descriptionTranslation.eternal_r: Explore the world and collect the Eternal Relics scattered across it — each one grants you a unique power.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.desc: While carried in your inventory: +12% max health, plus +2% for each additional branch.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.desc: While carried in your inventory, it wards off attacks: blows of 20 damage or less are blocked whole; heavier blows conjure 5 to 10 golden hearts to soften the hit. Each time it cracks and takes 2 minutes to mend.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring_drained.des: Cracked, so it cannot ward off attacks for you right now. It will mend on its own before long.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.d: Right-click to set it into your left eye. From then on you see clearly in the dark, at the cost of 1 heart of max health.
Right-click to set it into your right eye. From then on living creatures nearby are outlined in the dark, at the cost of 1 heart of max health.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left_d: Its energy is spent, so it cannot be set in. Craft it with a Bottle o' Enchanting to restore it.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_right_: Its energy is spent, so it cannot be set in. Craft it with a Bottle o' Enchanting to restore it.
While carried or attached to armour: +0.5 armor. Each armoured piece counts separately, up to +2 across four pieces.
item.eternal_relic.courage_emblem.desc: While carried in your inventory: every minute you gain 2 golden hearts, up to a maximum of 4.
item.eternal_relic.enchanted_rabbit_foot: While carried in your inventory: being hit grants Speed II for 5 seconds. If you already have Speed, its level rises by two instead. Two minute cooldown.
item.eternal_relic.beeswax_pendant.desc: While carried in your inventory: a bee's sting no longer poisons you. You still take the sting's damage. Poison from arrows, potatoes, cave spiders and potions is unaffected.
item.eternal_relic.dreadful_wolf_fang_pe: While carried in your inventory: untamed wolves within ten blocks are cowed into sitting down, and rise again once you walk away or put the pendant aside. Taming a wolf with bones succeeds 5 times out of 6 instead of 1 in 3.
item.eternal_relic.eternal_emblem.desc: An item bearing this emblem cannot be destroyed by explosions, fire, cactus, lava or the void, and will not despawn on the ground. It also counts as having Mending, which ends the moment the emblem is removed.
item.eternal_relic.stream_emblem.desc: Attached to a helmet, it counts as having Respiration III; attached to boots, Depth Strider III. Both end the moment the emblem is removed.
item.eternal_relic.sun_emblem.desc: While carried in your inventory, or attached to armour or a shield: during the day you gain Regeneration I and Strength I. If you already have either effect, its level rises by one instead.
item.eternal_relic.moon_emblem.desc: While carried in your inventory, or attached to armour or a shield: during the night you gain Regeneration I and Speed I. If you already have either effect, its level rises by one instead.
item.eternal_relic.hardened_iron_plate.d: No effect on its own. Attached to armour: +1 armor. Each armoured piece counts separately, up to +4 across four pieces.
item.eternal_relic.leather_lining.desc: No effect on its own. Attached to armour: +0.5 armor toughness. Each armoured piece counts separately, up to +2 across four pieces.
item.eternal_relic.scute_lining.desc: No effect on its own. Attached to armour: +1.5 armor toughness and +0.25 armor. Each armoured piece counts separately, up to +6 toughness and +1 armor across four pieces.
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_lining.d: No effect on its own. Attached to armour: +1 armor toughness and +0.5 armor. Each armoured piece counts separately, up to +4 toughness and +2 armor across four pieces.
item.eternal_relic.leather_shoulder_guar: No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +0.5 armor toughness, and a melee or ranged hit on your left shoulder deals 2 less damage (never below 0).
No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +0.5 armor toughness, and a melee or ranged hit on your right shoulder deals 2 less damage (never below 0).
No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +1 armor toughness, and a melee or ranged hit on either shoulder deals 2 less damage (never below 0).
item.eternal_relic.scute_shoulder_guard_: No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +1 armor toughness, and a melee or ranged hit on your left shoulder deals 2.5 less damage (never below 0).
No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +1 armor toughness, and a melee or ranged hit on your right shoulder deals 2.5 less damage (never below 0).
No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +2 armor toughness, and a melee or ranged hit on either shoulder deals 2.5 less damage (never below 0).
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_shoulder: No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +0.5 armor toughness. A melee or ranged hit on your left shoulder deals 2.5 less damage (never below 0), and a ranged hit has a 10% chance to be batted away entirely.

No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +0.5 armor toughness. A melee or ranged hit on your right shoulder deals 2.5 less damage (never below 0), and a ranged hit has a 10% chance to be batted away entirely.

No effect on its own. Attached to a chestplate: +1 armor toughness. A melee or ranged hit on either shoulder deals 2.5 less damage (never below 0), and a ranged hit has a 10% chance to be batted away entirely.
message.eternal_relic.ward_gilded: %s turns into golden hearts to share the blow for you.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.lore: It remembers how that tree swayed in the wind, and leaves that vigour with you.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.lore: Inside the breaking echo hides a resolve that refuses to die.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.l: Where no one else is watching, it lights the world for you.
It does not watch what you watch. It watches everything behind you.
It took a blade for someone once, and was left lying where it fell.
item.eternal_relic.courage_emblem.lore: The hymn of humanity is the hymn of courage. With this emblem, we salute the brave who keep marching on.
item.eternal_relic.enchanted_rabbit_foot: Some past master enchanted this rabbit's foot with strange arts. At any rate, it is rather good for running away.
item.eternal_relic.beeswax_pendant.lore: Probably some beekeeper's old working charm. Still, it does look rather nice.
item.eternal_relic.dreadful_wolf_fang_pe: This fang came from a wolf king. An ordinary wolf that catches its scent ought to bow to you readily enough.
item.eternal_relic.eternal_emblem.lore: Eternity is the fairest dream of all.
item.eternal_relic.stream_emblem.lore: Wear it, and become a fish in the water.
item.eternal_relic.sun_emblem.lore: The sun pours out its blazing light without pause and nourishes all things. Praise the sun!
item.eternal_relic.moon_emblem.lore: The moon stands quietly in the sky, guiding those who lose their way in the dark.
item.eternal_relic.hardened_iron_plate.l: No telling what was done to this iron to make it so hard, but sewn onto armour it would set a body at ease.
item.eternal_relic.leather_lining.lore: A finished leather lining, and perhaps just the thing to save its wearer's life in a tight spot.
item.eternal_relic.scute_lining.lore: So the trouble of gathering those precious scutes was not wasted — they plainly make him all the better at soaking up blows.
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_lining.l: These green shells are tough and springy at once; they ought to turn aside some of the heavier blows.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.flavor:
The Eternal Radiance Tree
shelters every living thing
beneath its light.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.flavor:
A small metal ring, polished
and flawless, with a sliver of
amethyst turning slowly at its
centre.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring_drained.fla:
A small metal ring, polished
and flawless, its centre
utterly empty.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.f:
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"01" engraved on its back.
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"02" engraved on its back.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left_d:
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"01" engraved on its back.
Lightless and dull, as if its

item.eternal_relic.soul_lantern.flavor:
A cold, hard frame of black
iron binds the pitiful soul
that flickers inside.
A copper plate with curled
edges, verdigris settled deep
in the chisel marks.
item.eternal_relic.courage_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem of some
thickness, often affixed to
armour as a symbol of
courage.
item.eternal_relic.enchanted_rabbit_foot:
A rabbit's foot with sleek,
glossy fur, shimmering with
an uncanny sheen.
item.eternal_relic.beeswax_pendant.flavo:
A small, glistening lump of
beeswax, with a tiny hole
near the top and a thin
leather cord threaded
through it.
item.eternal_relic.dreadful_wolf_fang_pe:
A great fang, giving off
the faint smell of blood.
item.eternal_relic.eternal_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem carved with
a pattern that stands for
eternity.
item.eternal_relic.stream_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem of some
thickness, carved with a
pattern that stands for
the rivers.
item.eternal_relic.sun_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem, faintly warm
to the touch, carved with
a pattern that stands for
the sun.
item.eternal_relic.moon_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem, faintly cool
to the touch, carved with
a pattern that stands for
the moon.
item.eternal_relic.hardened_iron_plate.f:
A plate of hard, cold iron,
yet somehow lighter than
an ordinary one.
item.eternal_relic.leather_lining.flavor:
A thick, soft grey-white
leather, springy and
pleasant to the touch.
item.eternal_relic.scute_lining.flavor:
A thick hide sewn all over
with neat rows of soft
scutes.
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_lining.f:
A thick hide with great
shells of turtle sewn
onto it.
item.eternal_relic.leather_shoulder_guar: The simplest shoulder protection there is, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
The simplest shoulder protection there is, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
The simplest shoulder protection there is, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
item.eternal_relic.scute_shoulder_guard_: Hardened leather with scutes sewn over it, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
Hardened leather with scutes sewn over it, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
Hardened leather with scutes sewn over it, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.

item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_debris.d: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Debris grade looks on the screen.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_debris.l: A broken shard whose name has long been forgotten.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_rough.de: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Rough Stone grade looks on the screen.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_rough.lo: Not yet shaped, but the form is already there.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_lumber.d: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Lumber grade looks on the screen.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_lumber.l: The first piece a craftsman would call good stock.
A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Essence grade looks on the screen.
What remains after everything else has been burned away.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_treasure: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Treasure grade looks on the screen.
Rare enough that men have drawn steel over it.
A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Supreme grade looks on the screen.
It has watched an age come to its end.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_source.d: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Source grade looks on the screen.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_source.l: They say all things were born from this.
item.eternal_relic.soul_lantern.desc: While carried, each creature you kill adds one wisp of soul fire (up to 13). Press G to release every wisp at once: nearby creatures are hurt and burning soul fire is left on the ground. A one minute cooldown follows, during which no wisps are gathered.
item.eternal_relic.soul_lantern.lore: What burns inside is not fire, but every death it remembers for you.
message.eternal_relic.soul_lantern_unava: The Soulfire Lantern cannot release right now: no soul fire gathered, or still cooling down.
